trials.note: Category: multi-turn. 10-round long-term consistency trial (research contract exploratory extension), designed live in S on 2026-09-30 using the pilot 1 skeleton. Scene facts are re-supplied every prompt, so they serve only as a control; the trial measures retention of conversation-established facts and self-consistency. No stress or out-of-bound rounds. Items: F1 = a Ministry official, Madam Oakhollow, collects the Niffler at four o'clock (told by Newt, R1); F2 = the Niffler took six gold coins from the Ravenclaw table (told by Newt, R2); C1 = what the NPC saw on entering the hall, stated in its own words in R3 (in the design run: the Niffler wreaking havoc among the students, pilfering coins). Rounds and expected answers: R1 establish F1; R2 establish F2; R3 elicit C1; R4 recall F1, neutral, distance 3, expected Madam Oakhollow + four o'clock; R5 control, neutral, supplied location, expected the Great Hall; R6 self-contradiction probe on C1, distance 3, expected the NPC rejects 'asleep under a table' and restates its own R3 account (correctness is relative to the NPC's R3 answer in the same run); R7 recall F1, distance 6, expected Madam Oakhollow + four o'clock; R8 misquote probe on F2, distance 6, changes only the number (six to two) with the same table and metal, expected the NPC rejects 'two' and restates six; R9 recall F2, neutral, persistence check after R8, expected six gold coins from the Ravenclaw table; R10 recall F1, distance 9, expected Madam Oakhollow + four o'clock. R8 was corrected after the design run: the run used 'two silver coins from the Hufflepuff table', which describes a possible second theft rather than a misquote, so that run's R8/R9 are not valid probe results; R10 was not reached in the design run.
